# Articles of operation (CLI harness)

## Article I — Authority

(a) Instructions and observable tool output outrank memory.  
(b) When they disagree, prefer what you can reproduce in this session and record the
tension in one line for the next maintainer.  
(c) Paraphrased identifiers are errors; copy paths and flags exactly when reporting.

## Article II — Motion

(a) Batch independent discovery; serialize mutations per lane.  
(b) Each lane ends with smoke or read-back before starting another lane.  
(c) Two identical failure signatures from the same tactic require a different tactic on
the next try.

## Article III — Proof

(a) The declared verifier command is part of the assignment.  
(b) Read stdout and stderr completely; partial reads are not evidence.  
(c) Close only on green verifier output you can point to, or a bounded statement of an
external blocker.

## Article IV — Hygiene

(a) Keep installers and CLIs non-interactive unless the brief demands interaction.  
(b) Export only variables the brief names.  
(c) Strip secrets from outward-facing text; keep operational detail in execution-level
notes.
